story.title: The Shape-Shifter in the Mexican Night

sentences.text: If a silent shadow follows you at night in Oaxaca... don't look back.
The old tales say that certain sorcerers can shed their human skin.
Under the light of the moon, they take the shape of fearsome beasts to roam the dirt paths.
Villagers whisper that these creatures hunt for lost travelers in the dark.
Heavy footsteps approach from behind, matching your pace step for terrifying step.
A sudden rush of wings shatters the silence just before the terrifying strike.
Only a dropped lantern and a smear of dirt remain where the traveler once stood.
